evidence: The finding's mechanism is wrong: later bot/draft re-reviews do not depend on provenance created by the initial review. products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:142-215 (`_inbox_rereview_carve_out`, called from the webhook task at tasks.py:872-880) recomputes provenance on every synchronize/reopen/retarget delivery from the tasks facade (`find_signal_implementation_run`, products/tasks/backend/facade/api.py:484-516, matching the TaskRun by pr_url or repo+branch) plus the registered resolver hook, and never looks up a prior ReviewRun, so a lost initial dispatch blocks nothing downstream. The broker publish is already retried: `process_inbox_pr_review.delay(...)` (products/stamphog/backend/facade/api.py:147-155) runs under Celery 5.3.6's default `task_publish_retry=True` / `max_retries: 3` (celery/app/defaults.py:269-278) and nothing under posthog/ overrides `publish_retry`. The receiver also deliberately re-fires on every later `output` save carrying the PR URL (receivers.py:75-79; tasks.py:1124-1128), and such saves are routine: `set_task_run_output` saves with update_fields=['output','updated_at'] on every agent-server sync (products/tasks/backend/facade/api.py:2151-2154) and the webhook backstop does the same (products/tasks/backend/webhooks.py:286-292); `process_inbox_pr_review` dedupes on the PR's current head (tasks.py:1201-1222) so a refire safely re-dispatches a missed initial review. The log-and-return contract mirrors the ReviewHog leg `_start_review` (receivers.py:246, 272-273) and is a tested design decision (products/review_hog/backend/tests/test_inbox_trigger.py:358-370): the helper runs inside tasks' save path and must never raise. The residual exposure (broker down beyond the ~1s publish-retry window AND no later output save or push ever) is the same as every `.delay()` in PostHog, and ReviewHog's own review still starts via Temporal; a transactional outbox is a defensive-paranoia ask, not a defect.
notes: I would change my mind if the webhook carve-out or the Stamphog engine were shown to require an existing inbox-provenance ReviewRun (rather than the tasks-facade lookup) before it re-reviews a bot-authored draft, or if posthog's Celery config disabled task_publish_retry.
